label: USAJOBS
terms_note: Official Search API (API key + User-Agent e-mail). Applications require a login.gov account — assisted browser for apply.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (official federal job search API, apply via login.gov).
auth: 1. Request an API key on the developer portal (free; e-mail address registered).
2. Headers on every call: `Host: data.usajobs.gov`, `User-Agent: <registration e-mail>`, `Authorization-Key: <key>`. Code-list endpoints need no key.

endpoints.notes: Keyword, PositionTitle, LocationName, Radius, JobCategoryCode, PayGradeLow/High, RemunerationMinimumAmount/MaximumAmount, HiringPath, Organization, DatePosted, ResultsPerPage (≤500), Page, PositionID …; SearchResult.SearchResultItems[].MatrixObjectDescriptor (PositionTitle, PositionURI, ApplyURI, Po
academichonors, agencysubelements, applicationstatuses, hiringpaths, occupationalseries, whomayapply, …

reference.limits: Search API: max 10,000 rows per query, 500 rows per page; code lists and dynamic search: no limits. - Free government API with registration; key + e-mail identify the caller. - The Terms-of-Use page (developer.usajobs.gov/general/terms-of-use) returned 'WHOOPS! USAJOBS has encountered an error' — terms text not readable today; no automation clause could be checked.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: USAJOBS API key requested on https://developer.usajobs.gov/ (free); sent as the Authorization-Key header on every call.

fields.name: email
fields.help: The e-mail address registered with the API key; USAJOBS requires it as the User-Agent header on every call.

me.note: Verified with a one-result search (USAJOBS has no account endpoint).

search.note: Federal announcements only. ResultsPerPage ≤ 500 and at most 10,000 rows per query. description carries QualificationSummary; PositionRemuneration, ApplyURI and UserArea.Details stay in raw. No published per-second limit.

get_posting.note: Looks the announcement up with the documented PositionID search parameter (there is no per-id path).

not_offered.apply: Page: 'not offered — candidates apply on usajobs.gov with a login.gov account' (ApplyURI is in raw).

evidence: host data.usajobs.gov: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
